verdict.rationale: Lever's Automation Hub is described as automatically handling routine actions such as archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates, and nurture can follow up automatically. Event-driven webhooks with event configuration let external systems react to Lever events. The evidence never shows how users define rules, conditions or event triggers inside Lever, so in-product rule authoring is only implied by marketing copy, and webhooks need external tooling to act. Missing for 10: documented rule/trigger builder (conditions, event types, action chaining), in-product event-to-action configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
